title: Finite interval covers of simplex faces
statement: For a finite linearly ordered subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n\}$, an interval cover of the face $F(S)$ is a finite union of full faces $F(I)$ indexed by nonempty consecutive intervals $I$ in the induced order on $S$, contained in $F(S)$, and containing every vertex and every edge between consecutive elements of $S$. The empty union is allowed only for the empty ambient face.
